name: lostcampus
description: Plataforma web basada en servicios para objetos perdidos del Tecnológico de Celaya

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,items,matching,claims,notify,web -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,white "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/items-service" "npm run dev -w services/matching-service" "npm run dev -w services/claims-service" "npm run dev -w services/notify-service" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n gateway,items,matching,claims,notify "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/items-service" "npm run dev -w services/matching-service" "npm run dev -w services/claims-service" "npm run dev -w services/notify-service"
